name: What is the typical process for scheduling a home repair with City Dweller LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for scheduling a home repair with City Dweller LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for scheduling a home repair with City Dweller LLC typically begins with you contacting us via phone or our website to describe your repair needs. We will then schedule a convenient time for a site visit to assess the damage or issue. Following the assessment, we provide a detailed estimate outlining the scope of work, materials, and cost. Once approved, we schedule the repair at a time that works for you, ensuring minimal disruption to your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contact us to describe your repair, we'll assess the issue, provide an estimate, and then schedule the work.
